profile.headline: Software Engineer 2 @ Microsoft | Developing Scalable Software Solutions
profile.summary: I'm a seasoned software engineer with a passion for building scalable, high-impact solutions across industries. Over the past decade, I've led cross-functional teams and delivered full-stack applications using technologies such as Java, Spring Boot, Angular, and AWS. I thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments where innovation drives results, and I take pride in mentoring junior engineers and fostering inclusive team cultures. Whether I'm architecting enterprise-grade systems or optimizing legacy platforms, I bring a thoughtful, results-driven mindset to every challenge I take on.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.locationName: Grand Rapids, Michigan, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Led the consolidation of Customer Support platforms into a unified Global Support Solution for Microsoft. Designed and implemented high-performance APIs that met stringent reliability, latency, authentication, and security standards, while achieving full unit test coverage. Authored service contracts and drove engineering excellence by developing comprehensive monitoring systems, dashboards, and Troubleshooting Guides (TSGs) for all new endpoints. These APIs collectively support millions of daily requests and manage thousands of customer support cases.

• Solved a major customer pain-point where search endpoints were timing out for large tenants.  I implemented a caching solution as well as separated the use-case into new Search v3 and Export v2 methods to address previous inefficiencies and customer issues when using these endpoints.  I reduced the API's failure rate by 99\% and improved latency by 90\%. 

• Provisioned and deployed services in Sovereign Cloud.

• Led an effort to improve CI/CD for our services.  I expanded code coverage and reduced deployment failures by re-introducing functional testing.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed, developed, and maintained dashboards supporting tens of thousands of Prime Merchants on Amazon.  These tools actively guide sellers to meet critical delivery performance metrics required for Prime Program eligibility. I played a key role in ensuring system reliability, usability, and compliance with operational standards, directly influencing seller behavior and program integrity.

• Launched new dashboards for Prime Sellers in North America.  To power these new dashboards, I produced backend code which implemented paginated ElasticSearch queries to fetch aggregated seller metrics within 180ms.

• Prepared our North American services to handle Q4 2020 peak traffic of over 1500tps.  To accomplish this, I documented APIs, calculated SQS (Simple Queue Service) traffic capabilities, provisioned auto-scaled tables in DynamoDb, and ensured capacity of ECS (Elastic Container Service) instances.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Backend Lead for a Spring Boot microservice pilot project aimed at streamlining auditor workflows through automated document attribute extraction. Oversaw backend feature development, managed the Linux-based development environment, and conducted rigorous code reviews to ensure quality and consistency. Collaborated with and helped manage an offshore engineering team, while onboarding and mentoring new hires to accelerate team productivity and cohesion.

• Engineered an idempotent document processing pipeline using Apache Zookeeper and Kafka. This pipeline connected to other internal APIs that performed zone-based optical character recognition.

• Cooperated with frontend specialists using Spring Cloud Contracts to ensure consistency between backend endpoints and frontend consumers.

positions.title: Computer Support Consultant
positions.description: • Support Technician and Helpdesk for the University's Administration Offices of over 200 employees. Responsible for providing professional customer support, troubleshooting hardware and software for computers and printers.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Worked alongside a team of students and professionals to build a
proof-of-concept Android mobile app that allows automotive dealerships to file
insurance claims with Ally.

• Engineered RESTful calls to both Ally’s existing security token service and a
development database. This required learning Ally’s existing systems,
multi-threading the app to allow internet connections, and formatting database
input/output with JSON libraries.

• Contributed to Ally’s data conversion process by refactoring legacy code for
performance increases and readability + maintainability improvements.

positions.title: IT Customer Support
positions.description: Desktop Support and Heldesk for the campus staff.  Responsible for understanding Active Directory, System Center, and imaging computers with Zenworks and Clonezilla.

positions.title: Peer Tutor
positions.description: Peer Tutor in both one-on-one and group setting by appointment.  Responsible for helping students learn Algebra, English, and Introductory Chinese.

honors.title: CAEN Student of the Month
honors.description: "Throughout his employment Keifer has provided excellent customer service, along with perfect attendance.  He has also provided good leadership and training to our new student employees.  Recently Keifer volunteered to assist the Engineering Events team in planning and running activities for Homecoming weekend.  Keifer is a valuable member of the EACS team and we are proud to nominate him for student of the month."

projects.title: MTG Pilot
projects.description:
Created MTGPilot.com: a full-stack web application built with Angular, Spring Boot, and MySQL. Designed to help Magic the Gathering players track and manage the financial value of their card collections. Integrated with TCGPlayer’s API to fetch real-time market prices and visualize trends using Google Charts. Implemented robust security protocols including SSL, OAuth authentication, and password hashing to ensure data integrity and user protection.

View a sample account by logging in with user: test, password: 123456
